title: Testing GTA 6 Public Transport: A Journey Across Leonida
description: How good is GTA 6's public transport? Push Square put Rockstar's fully functioning system to the test in a unique journey across Leonida.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Putting GTA 6's Public Transport to the Test

As anticipation for Grand Theft Auto 6 continues to build, players are constantly looking out for details regarding the sheer depth of the open world. Rockstar Games has talked extensively about how the fictional state of Leonida will feature its own fully functioning public transport system, giving players the freedom to catch a bus or a train to pretty much wherever they want to go.

To see how this feature actually holds up in practice, the team at Push Square decided to put it to the ultimate test for their official YouTube channel. Instead of stealing a sports car or hijacking a helicopter like most players usually do, they embarked on a real journey across the map using exclusively public transportation.

## A Whole New Way to Experience Leonida

Rockstar has always been a pioneer in creating believable, breathing virtual worlds. From the detailed ecosystems of Red Dead Redemption 2 to the dynamic urban environments of past GTA titles, immersion is always a core pillar of their game design. The introduction of a working bus and rail network in GTA 6 takes that philosophy a step further.

Based on the media coverage and testing, relying strictly on public transit changes the fundamental pacing of the game. Instead of rushing through the map at top speed, players are forced to slow down and appreciate the scenery of Leonida. Whether it is waiting for a bus to arrive, watching the city pass by from a window, or taking a scenic train ride, these mechanics offer a fresh, grounded perspective on open-world exploration.

## Is It Practical for Everyday Gameplay?

While hardcore speedrunners or mission-focused players will likely stick to stolen vehicles for maximum efficiency, the public transport system adds an incredible layer of roleplay and realism. It caters to players who enjoy absorbing the atmosphere, offering a unique alternative for those who prefer a slower, more deliberate pace in the world of Leonida.

## Editor's Take

Push Square's transit experiment highlights Rockstar's commitment to world-building details. While commuting via bus and train might not be the fastest way to complete missions, it breathes life into Leonida, turning the map from a mere playground into a living, functioning environment.
